methodological_references.role: Sample frame, pretests, nonresponse, transparency; not endorsement

experiments.name: Independent second-look pilot
experiments.population_frame: Buyer-owned historical U.S. LTL invoices meeting written pilot eligibility, with independently checked inclusion and excluded carriers/time periods documented.
experiments.sample_selection: Predeclare frame, random or consecutive selection, de-duplicate invoices and record inaccessible packages; do not select only invoices already known to be wrong.
experiments.comparison_group: Blind independent reviewer of the identical source package before being shown RETALLY's alerts.

primary_metric.name: Evidence-supported alert precision
primary_metric.numerator: RETALLY positive alerts independently adjudicated as substantiated overcharges under the controlling dated authority
primary_metric.denominator: All RETALLY positive alerts for eligible invoices, including rejected and unresolved alerts

experiments.positive_signal: A prospective preapproved precision target is met, with denominators, uncertainty, disagreement and abstentions disclosed; this alone does not establish ROI or readiness.
experiments.negative_signal: An unacceptably high adjudicated false-positive or unsupported-alert rate, missing authority, or unresolved adjudication.
experiments.independent_reviewer: Reviewer has no access to RETALLY alert label when first assigning ground truth; conflicts go to a second documented adjudicator.
required_evidence: Executed buyer authority and data-rights scope
Original invoice, BOL/proof-of-delivery, contract and date-applicable tariff
Payment and credit evidence, matched to invoice identity
Independent ground-truth adjudication log and operator effort
confounders: Credit or refund occurring before pilot
experiments.missingness_policy: Retain eligible missing or indeterminate alerts in flow counts and sensitivity analyses; never silently recode unresolved as correct.
experiments.stop_rule: Stop external processing on revoked buyer consent, cross-tenant leakage, unauthorized data, contractual ambiguity or rate-authority conflict.
experiments.next_internal_step: Prepare a blank data-rights/labeling charter and synthetic reviewer disagreement examples; do not invite buyers automatically.

experiments.name: Historical tariff and NMFC chronology
experiments.unit_of_analysis: Dated contract/tariff/NMFC fixture and rated shipment outcome
experiments.population_frame: Synthetic boundary fixtures surrounding documented issuance/effective dates and representative contract overrides; real claims excluded pending legal review.
experiments.sample_selection: Predeclare pre-/post-effective dates, each side of midnight, supplements, withdrawn proposals and contract exceptions; include negative controls.
experiments.comparison_group: Independent reviewer reconstruction using separately frozen dated authorities, not a live-only tariff lookup.

primary_metric.name: Boundary classification agreement
primary_metric.numerator: Eligible boundary fixtures whose independently determined expected treatment matches engine output
primary_metric.denominator: All preregistered eligible chronological fixtures, including abstentions and rejects

experiments.positive_signal: No future-effective rule applied to a prior shipment and agreement meets a separately approved fixture coverage and quality threshold.
experiments.negative_signal: Any future-supplement retroactive application, unsupported contract-override assumption or silently accepted missing rule.
experiments.independent_reviewer: Separate tariff reviewer checks actual text and precedence while the engine authors remain blinded to expected fixture labels.
required_evidence: Dated source copies with retrieval timestamps and license scope
Published issuance and effective dates
Signed contract precedence where applicable or explicit absence
Expected outcome and reject/abstain trace per fixture
experiments.missingness_policy: Missing rule editions are indeterminate, never default to currently available edition.
experiments.stop_rule: Block any customer-specific legal interpretation, unpublished tariff, unauthorized NMFC text or attempted carrier claim.
experiments.next_internal_step: Generate source-pinned synthetic boundary matrix for the December 12 NMFC supplement without treating it as currently effective.

experiments.name: Pricing comprehension and trust
experiments.population_frame: People with documented U.S. LTL freight-budget or audit-buying responsibility; identity and recruitment frame documented independently.
experiments.sample_selection: Randomly assign equally informative fictional fee explanations; pretest balanced wording, record nonresponse and retain assignment log.
experiments.comparison_group: Posted-percentage offer versus engagement-confirmed percentage with identical hypothetical amounts, service scope and recovery exclusions.

primary_metric.name: Correct all-in fee comprehension
primary_metric.numerator: Respondents correctly stating example fee, eligible-recovery base and exclusion after randomized exposure
primary_metric.denominator: All eligible randomized respondents under prespecified missing-response policy

experiments.positive_signal: Difference in comprehension exceeds a preregistered meaningful threshold with uncertainty and nonresponse disclosed; no automatic pricing change.
experiments.negative_signal: No meaningful improvement, reduced trust, confusion about no-recovery fees or evidence of leading wording.
experiments.independent_reviewer: Survey analyst unaffiliated with copy design reviews item validity, assignment, balance and blind outcome coding.
required_evidence: Consented recruitment and role-screening record
Exact stimulus wording and random-assignment recipe
All answer options including do-not-know
Response/nonresponse flow and preregistered inference plan
confounders: Conflation of savings found with cash recovered
experiments.missingness_policy: Report uncontacted, nonresponse and partial-response separately; no post-hoc deletion of confused respondents.
experiments.stop_rule: Stop for unconsented contact, personal data overcollection or unauthorized comparative advertising.
experiments.next_internal_step: Draft balanced fictional price-explanation variants and a comprehension question key; no outbound buyer contact.

experiments.name: Serviceable-account market falsification
experiments.unit_of_analysis: Unique eligible shipper account, not commodity shipment dollar
experiments.population_frame: Documented U.S. shipper firm frame with known mode, LTL use, invoice volume and permitted geographic/vertical strata.
experiments.sample_selection: Document frame coverage, deduplicate legal entities, stratify by shipper size/mode/carrier access and report exclusions; pilot recruitment needs separate approval.
experiments.comparison_group: Nonresponsive/ineligible frame entries and incumbent-processed accounts retained as explicit denominator groups.

primary_metric.name: Qualified reachable-account fraction
primary_metric.numerator: Distinct sampled accounts satisfying scope, ability to authorize, historical data access and prespecified unit-economics screens
primary_metric.denominator: All unique sampled candidate accounts in defined covered strata including ineligible/nonresponsive records

experiments.positive_signal: A bounded, transparent segment demonstrates favorable reachability under a documented sample design; no extrapolation without supported weighting.
experiments.negative_signal: Unavailable data rights, dominant incumbent lock-in, low reachable fraction or uneconomic analyst costs.
experiments.independent_reviewer: Sampling analyst audits frame provenance, inclusion/exclusion ledger, nonresponse and any permitted weighting assumptions.
required_evidence: Licensed account frame and frame construction metadata
Shipper-level LTL usage confirmation under permitted methods
Documented data-access and buyer authority
Operating-cost assumptions and nonresponse table
confounders: BTS commodity value mistaken for audit revenue
Shippers using parcel or truckload rather than LTL
experiments.missingness_policy: Nonresponders remain in reported frame denominator; publish no population precision from a convenience sample.
experiments.stop_rule: Stop at privacy/contract limits, unlicensed list acquisition or use of freight value as recovery revenue.
experiments.next_internal_step: Specify candidate verticals and a deduplicated blank frame schema, with no speculative TAM dollar calculation.

experiments.name: Independent capability and negative-control comparison
experiments.unit_of_analysis: Rights-cleared test case including source documents, target answers and expected evidence trail
experiments.population_frame: Public/licensed synthetic freight invoices and negative controls covering missing terms, duplicates, bad OCR, ambiguous carriers and unsupported source.
experiments.sample_selection: Predeclare complexity strata and include easy, difficult, tampered and ambiguous examples; avoid cherry-picking demos.
experiments.comparison_group: Same frozen fixture labels and adjudication rubric across RETALLY and only legitimately accessible comparison systems; unavailable rivals are NOT marked failures.

primary_metric.name: Fully supported correct resolution rate
primary_metric.numerator: Fixtures receiving independently confirmed correct resolution with traceable cited source and correct abstention when necessary
primary_metric.denominator: All eligible fixtures assigned to each actually tested system, with abstentions and errors accounted for

experiments.positive_signal: Preregistered accuracy and traceability conditions met without material security failures; no competitor advantage inferred when rival access missing.
experiments.negative_signal: Fabricated authority, wrong invoice associations, false positives or unsupported claims of rival inferiority.
experiments.independent_reviewer: Blind evaluator inspects sealed expected labels and records disagreement, missing vendor access, and licensing constraints.
required_evidence: Fixture provenance/redistribution rights
Sealed independent labels and exceptions rubric
System version, run identity and complete output traces
Capability access authorization for each compared system
experiments.missingness_policy: Missing competitor execution is NOT_TESTED, never score zero or not-supported.
experiments.stop_rule: Never reverse engineer protected code, use private competitor data, scrape gated services or test without authorization.
experiments.next_internal_step: Prepare common rights-cleared synthetic test manifest with adversarial negative controls.

experiments.name: Realized recovery and contribution economics
experiments.unit_of_analysis: Distinct contractually eligible paid recovery episode with linked source invoice and cash chronology
experiments.population_frame: All eligible claims initiated in a consented cohort with a predefined follow-up window; settled, failed, open and reversed outcomes must remain visible.
experiments.sample_selection: Consecutive consented cases with controls for duplicate invoices, split payments and inherited pre-RETALLY claims.
experiments.comparison_group: All zero-recovery, rejected, disputed, reversed and still-open cases retained for conversion and contribution reconciliation.

primary_metric.name: Realized net contribution per initiated eligible case
primary_metric.numerator: Cash-collected permitted RETALLY fees less attributable labor, acquisition, processor costs, write-offs and reversals in the defined period
primary_metric.denominator: All initiated eligible claim episodes including zero-fee outcomes and unfinished cases

experiments.positive_signal: Independently reconciled positive contribution for the full inception cohort, with cash/credit attribution and remaining liabilities included; not guaranteed future ROI.
experiments.negative_signal: Credits mistaken for cash, double recovery attribution, negative labor-adjusted contribution or uncovered reversals.
experiments.independent_reviewer: Independent accountant reconstructs bank/credit traces and signed engagement terms from source systems without relying on RETALLY summaries.
required_evidence: Signed fee basis and authority
Original invoices, net credits/refunds and carrier settlements
Dated bank cash receipts and reversal chains
Complete labor, processing and acquisition cost ledger
confounders: Carrier credit after engagement but unrelated to RETALLY
experiments.missingness_policy: Open claims, uncollected credits and unknown costs are separately disclosed; never impute them to cash collected.
experiments.stop_rule: Stop on missing signed customer authority, bank proof mismatch, fee-eligibility uncertainty or double-attribution risk.
experiments.next_internal_step: Define a blank audit-ready cash-event schema and test synthetic reversal math before any real-data handling.
